## Learning goals

- I can describe colour using hue, saturation, and value.
- I can explain the difference between RGB screens and CMYK printing.
- I can explain how opacity changes the result.

::: {.callout-note}
The lesson uses the [BBC guidance for visually and hearing impaired audiences](https://www.bbc.com/editorialguidelines/guidance/visually-and-hearing-impaired-audiences) as its accessibility reference and keeps only the diagrams needed to explain each decision.
:::
